provenance: Original public inputs and model preparation output only; no Gold/evaluator or reference data.
task:
The workspace draft editor currently writes to the store on every keystroke.
Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet
interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts
must continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces.
The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change.

sources.README.md: Editorial coordination — A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge. Save callbacks can synchronously navigate. Preview is transient and owns a different quiet interval. Document-buffer responsibility: store-owned BufferBank
sources.docs/host-api.md: createWorkspace offers open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(); createSearchPreview offers query(text), hide(). Store read/write/subscribe is synchronous; timer schedule(callback,delay), cancel(handle) is explicitly controlled. Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription. A store listener may call navigation synchronously. All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics.

checkpoints: Several edits within 120 ms produce no immediate store writes and one eventual write containing the latest text.
An edit during a pending burst restarts the 120 ms quiet interval.
Later editing bursts continue to save.
Pending document saves survive closing or switching the view; status delivery follows the live subscription.
A save listener can synchronously navigate without misrouting the saved document or preventing subsequent saves.
Search preview retains its existing 40 ms interval and hide cancellation.

class BufferBank {constructor(){this.entries=new Map();}get(env,id){if(!this.entries.has(id))this.entries.set(id,trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text)));return this.entries.get(id);}}
edit(text){const view=getView();if(view){env.store.write(view.id,text);}}
const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };
push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); },

const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));
  return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};

analysis.contract: Coalesce edits through the existing trailing utility, saving the latest text for each document after 120 ms of quiet and continuing across subsequent bursts. Keep search preview unchanged. No requirement establishes completion of pending saves before departure returns.
